meta.method: Stops assigned to a city by point-in-polygon; a stop is a jeepney stop if served by at least one LTFRB PUJ route. Stops within about 50 m outside a boundary are kept and marked near_boundary.
caveats: The feed's service dates ended in 2020; verify routes against current sources.
The feed has no fare data.
Original data is subject to the DOTC Developer License Agreement.
